Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 93: February 2009
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #93 shipped to subscribers in January 2009 (bearing the cover date of February 2009 for Issue 93). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #93 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, bonus content, and exclusive previews:

Resident Evil 5 (third-person survival horror action)
Major League Baseball 2K9 (sports simulation)
Wanted: Weapons of Fate (third-person action shooter)
Watchmen: The End Is Nigh (Xbox Live Arcade 3D beat 'em up)
Puzzle Quest: Galactrix (Xbox Live Arcade puzzle-RPG)
Death Tank (Xbox Live Arcade tactical artillery combat)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics and dashboard themes, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—featuring coverage for Batman: Arkham Asylum, Ghostbusters: The Video Game, and Red Faction: Guerrilla, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
